newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Credit Lyonnais sets Guangshen Railway warrants.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais sets Guangshen Railway warrants.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Financial Products (Guernsey) Ltd said on Monday it has launched 800 million American-style call warrants on newly-listed Guangshen Railway Co Ltd at HK$0.08 per warrant.
The conversion ratio is one warrant per share at an exercise price of HK$2.55.
Guangshen Railway began trading in Hong Kong in May, with an issue price of HK$2.91.

The warrants, with an expected payment date of October 21, 1996, and an expected listing date of October 23, 1996, carry a gearing of 3.67 times and an all-in premium of 12.25 percent, Credit Lyonnais said.
An application will be made to list the warrants on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
